lead_raw_text:
The structure of K2Ca8 (reduced formula KCa4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with a unit cell containing 20 atoms across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ca and K centers each surrounded by 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, with Ca–Ca and Ca–K distances around 3.52–3.64 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ca-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, as well as edge- and corner/face-sharing between K- and Ca-centered polyhedra.
